component.name: Sulafat
Sulafat
component.summary: Connect to Linux/Unix hosts via SSH
Conecte-se a hosts Linux/Unix via SSH

description.p: Sulafat is the SSH client of the Lyra Enterprise Linux ecosystem, for connecting to Linux/Unix desktops and servers. It works on any modern Linux distribution, with GTK4/libadwaita giving it native visual integration with GNOME and Lyra.

Sulafat é o cliente SSH do ecossistema Lyra Enterprise Linux, para conexão com máquinas Linux/Unix (desktops e servidores). Funciona em qualquer distribuição Linux moderna, com integração visual nativa ao GNOME e ao Lyra via GTK4/libadwaita.

ul.li: Hosts managed straight from your existing ~/.ssh/config, with search, groups and color
Sessions in tabs, powered by the real OpenSSH client and an embedded VTE terminal
Keys, ssh-agent, known_hosts, certificates, ProxyJump: all handled by OpenSSH itself
Quick connect to user@host without saving a profile
One click to open a host's files over SFTP in the default file manager

description.p: Redesigned application icon with clearer SSH terminal and key imagery.
